obd.connectSubtitle: ELM327-compatible Bluetooth LE adapters — read codes, emissions readiness, and live data, then diagnose in Chat.
obd.step1: Plug the adapter into the OBD-II port (under the dash, left of the steering column).
obd.step2: Turn the ignition ON (engine off or running). Wait for the adapter light.
obd.step3: Tap Scan (or Connect in Chrome), then pick your adapter from the list. You don't need to pair it in phone Settings first.
obd.step4: We read the check engine light, stored / pending / permanent codes, emissions readiness, freeze frame, live data, and VIN.
obd.bleOnlyBanner: Works with ELM327-compatible Bluetooth LE adapters.
obd.dualModeBanner: Android: try Bluetooth LE first. If your ELM327 is Classic-only (no BLE), switch to Classic Bluetooth.
obd.bleOnlyNote: Look for “BLE”, “Bluetooth 4.0+”, or “works with iPhone” on the package. Wi-Fi adapters aren't supported yet.
obd.dualModeNote: BLE works with most modern ELM327 clones. Classic Bluetooth (SPP) covers older non-BLE dongles on Android only. Wi-Fi adapters aren't supported yet.
obd.bleWebNote: In a browser, use Chrome. Classic Bluetooth and Wi-Fi adapters can't connect from the web — use the Android app for Classic.
obd.scanningClassicHint: Pair the adapter in Android Settings if it isn't listed, keep ignition ON, then tap it. First Classic connect may show a system pairing prompt.
obd.noClassicDevicesYet: No Classic adapters yet. Pair your ELM327 in Android Bluetooth settings, or tap Discover nearby.
obd.protocolHint: Leave on Automatic. If the car doesn't answer after the adapter connects, pick a common CAN preset and try again.
obd.selfCheckFailed: Self-check failed. Check ignition ON and adapter pairing, then retry.
obd.closeOtherAppsHint: Only one app can use the adapter at a time. Close other OBD apps before connecting.
obd.iosUnsupported: Live Bluetooth OBD isn't available on this device. Enter the fault code or upload an OBD screenshot.
obd.browserUnsupported: Bluetooth isn't available in this browser. Try Chrome, or enter the fault code / upload an OBD screenshot.
obd.iosTip: Use a Bluetooth LE (BLE) ELM327 adapter. Turn the ignition ON before you scan.
obd.workingHint: Keep the phone near the adapter and stay on this screen.
obd.scanningHint: Keep the adapter plugged in with the ignition ON. Tap your adapter when it appears.
obd.noDevicesYet: No adapters found yet. Move closer, confirm the adapter light is on, then Scan again.
obd.injectedHint: Diagnosis was sent to Chat. You can Read again or Disconnect here.
obd.dashboardSyncedHint: Codes and sensors were saved to this vehicle’s Dashboard. Ask AI to open diagnosis in Chat, or Read again / Disconnect.
obd.noCodes: No stored, pending, or permanent codes reported.
obd.errorGeneric: OBD connection or read failed. Unplug the adapter for 10 seconds, turn the ignition ON, and try again.
obd.toolsSectionHint: Optional hardware preferences. Change these anytime — they only adjust Connect OBD visibility, not diagnosis quality.
obd.prefToggleHelp: Enable Bluetooth OBD connection (ELM327-compatible adapters). When off, you can still enter codes manually or upload screenshots.
obd.prefUnsetHint: Off by default. Turn on when you have an ELM327-compatible OBD-II adapter.
obd.prefPromptTitle: Do you use an OBD adapter?
obd.prefPromptBody: If you have an OBD-II Bluetooth adapter, we can show Connect OBD. If not, keep using Enter fault code or an OBD screenshot (e.g. from a parts-store scan).
obd.prefPromptNote: You can change this later in Settings → Tools / Garage.
obd.iosPreferManual: If live Bluetooth isn't available, use Enter fault code or an OBD screenshot.
obd.noAdapterLiveHint: Bluetooth OBD is off. Enable “I have an OBD-II adapter” in Settings to connect, or use Enter fault code / OBD screenshot.
obd.bleBlockedByPref: Turn on “I have an OBD-II adapter” in Settings before connecting Bluetooth OBD.
obd.mileageSkippedDecrease: OBD odometer is not higher than the archive. Mileage was not reduced.
obd.mileageSkippedJump: OBD odometer jumped too far from the archive. Mileage was not overwritten.
obd.lockedNote: Won't connect: {{list}} — these only work inside their own apps.
obd.step_search: Finding your car's protocol (first connect can take up to 15 seconds)…
obd.step_readiness: Checking the check engine light and emissions monitors…
obd.step_codes: Reading stored, pending, and permanent codes…
obd.kindHelp: Pending = seen once, not confirmed yet. Permanent = clears only after the car re-tests itself, even if the light is off.
obd.smog_ready: Likely ready for an OBD emissions test.
obd.smog_not_ready: Not ready yet — {{count}} monitor(s) incomplete. Drive normally for a few days (city and highway), then check again.
obd.smog_mil_on: Would fail an OBD emissions test while the check engine light is on.
obd.smog_unknown: Readiness couldn't be estimated for this vehicle.
obd.smogNote: Estimate based on typical US rules (2001+ allows 1 incomplete monitor, 1996–2000 allows 2). Your state's rules may differ.
obd.freezeFrameFor: Freeze frame — conditions when {{code}} was stored
obd.vin_match: Matches the VIN saved for this vehicle.
obd.vin_mismatch: Doesn't match the VIN saved for this vehicle. Make sure the right vehicle is selected before you rely on this scan.
obd.vin_missing: This vehicle has no VIN saved yet.
obd.appVersionUnsupported: Live Bluetooth OBD isn't available in this app version yet. Enter the fault code or upload an OBD screenshot.
obd.simBanner: Internal test only. Scripted ELM327 replies — not a real car or Bluetooth link.
